placeholders.@FABLE_ID@: A Fable-class id injected at test time. A real Fable id never lands in a fixture.

notes: Contract section 5.4 (R3-f). Each vector is a reply whose receipt is the complete receipt. The tests take the receipt file to be the compact JSON of reply.receipt after the Fable id is injected, so receipt_sha256 is the sha256 of those UTF-8 bytes. A real receiver hashes its own file. The limit is 16384 UTF-8 bytes of the reply as sent; the reference serializes compact JSON with separators , and : and no ASCII escaping. A trimmed reply removes observed_models entries from the end, one at a time, until it fits, never the root entry and never an entry whose model matches fableId. It keeps the order and every other receipt field, and observed_models is never added to unobserved. expect.kept_always lists units that must survive. A reply still over the limit becomes kind failed, reason reply-too-large, receipt null.

vectors.name: over the limit with Sonnet units
